decisions.question: S28's plan fails one item of hsdd-phase-plan's Phase Design Checklist on purpose, 'Phase 1 defines all shared types and contract-bounded interfaces': the replay tool comes first and each contract's declarations land in its own first producing phase (.3 to .5). Rework the plan once, or accept the deviation?

options.label: Accept the deviation
options.consequence: The plan stands: shared types land as a band (.3 to .5) before any logic phase, and every producing gate can replay because the tool's sets land before the contracts that need them.

options.label: Rework so phase 1 holds every type
options.consequence: Phase 1 would hold about 2,900 lines, about seven PEs, against the checklist's own 'Each phase has at most 8 OpenSpec tasks' and the review window; or the tool would follow the types and the first producing gates could not replay, against ADR-001 item 9.

decisions.why: Two checklist items conflict here, and the plan keeps the intent of the one it breaks: every shared type and contract-bounded surface lands before any phase that uses it, and logic follows types under fp-progression. A rework could only trade one checklist failure for another. The plan records the reasoning as its D1, and the root development flow wording is a note for reconcile.

decisions.question: nidana.model now has 14 phases, past HSDD's 'add a level, do not widen' tip. Decompose it into children before going on, or keep it a leaf-parent?

options.label: Keep it a leaf-parent
options.consequence: One plan of 14 phases with three parallel pairs; consumers can start after .3 or .5.

options.label: Decompose it
options.consequence: Children would split nidana_dart_contracts (one public library holding all three contracts' declarations) or give the replay tool a node of its own; ADR-002 item 3 gives each package one owning node and ADR-001 item 10 one producing leaf-parent per api or shared-model contract, so either split needs an ADR change, and a replay-tool node would produce no contract.

decisions.why: Accepted governance gives the leaf-parent a stated reason (ADR-002 item 3, ADR-001 item 10 as amended in S24), so this is not the shape stop. The cost is a long plan; the plan already marks its parallel lanes. The signal that would change this: phases that cannot be kept to one review sitting.
